objective: Add a deterministic integrity gate for AudioContext output-clock evidence before render-timeline claims are composed into deployment-bound audio evidence.

comparison_against_prior_work.non_duplication: The prior artifact composes evidence layers and preserves cross-layer contradictions. This slice validates the internal clock consistency of the render-timeline layer itself.

completed: Added monotonicity checks for context, output-performance, and sampling clocks.
Added bounded delta-drift detection between AudioContext and performance timelines.
Preserved unavailable baseLatency and outputLatency as unobservable rather than zero.
Added deterministic evidence digests and seven boundary tests.
limits: No live immutable deployment was sampled.
No physical iPhone Safari evidence was collected.
Drift thresholds remain configurable engineering policy rather than normative browser limits.
next_action: Add a browser-side sampler adapter that captures getOutputTimestamp, baseLatency, outputLatency, and performance.now observations from one immutable deployment session, then feed only consistent output into the composed audio evidence packet.
